_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in your values. Remove _comment lines.
session_label: Attendance Mode Test — EEE Block B, Room 201  |  2026-08-27
_comment2: class_id / course_code are the human-readable codes used everywhere in the app (classroom page shows the class_id, e.g. 'ELT'; course page shows the course_code, e.g. 'CSC301') — NOT MongoDB ObjectIds. The lecturer_email above must belong to the lecturer actually assigned to this course, or an admin account, or every request 403s.
_comment2b: device_id must exactly match the deviceId the classroom was registered with (visible/editable via Edit Classroom in the dashboard). The image upload endpoint rejects any request whose deviceId doesn't match — this simulates the camera's identity, not a physical device you own.
_comment3: Test A3 (export) cannot be automated — export runs entirely client-side in the browser with no backend endpoint. It is verified manually via the dashboard UI; see the script's module docstring. This field is unused but left here in case a backend export endpoint is added later.
_comment4: Local folders containing .jpg/.jpeg/.png photos of each registered student
_comment5: For B1 accuracy testing — one entry per trial.
images_dir: folder of frames captured during that trial (the camera images).
ground_truth_present: matric numbers of enrolled students physically present.
unregistered_present: matric numbers of people in the room who are NOT enrolled.
Run at different distances and lighting conditions.
_comment6: OCCUPANCY MODE (tests C1/C2, D1) — used for /classrooms/{classId}/image people-counting, separate from face recognition above. occupancy_over_capacity_dir needs a frame showing MORE people than the classroom's real capacity — with only a handful of test people, temporarily lower the classroom's capacity via Edit Classroom in the dashboard (then restore it afterward) rather than trying to gather dozens of people. occupancy_under_capacity_dir is optional, used only by C2 to also confirm no alert fires when under capacity.
_comment7: For D1 accuracy testing — one entry per trial, same live-capture workflow as recognition_trials.
true_count: the actual number of people physically in frame when the images were captured — count them yourself at capture time, this is your ground truth.
Vary density/distance/occlusion between trials, same as B1's lighting/distance variation.
